    The contract other plugins compile against: VaultApi and the lock state it reports, credentials with their kinds and descriptors, the anchored credential chooser's request and result, how a credential looks in a picker, and SSH key import sources and results. Close each Credential right after use. Exported by the plugin descriptor; nothing else in the plugin is.

    TypeKindSummary
    CredentialclassThe caller's own copy of a secret.
    CredentialDescriptorrecordA credential without its secret, as VaultApi.credentials() lists it and the pickers return it.
    CredentialPickRequestrecordWhere VaultApi.pick(WindowHandle, CredentialPickRequest) shows its chooser and what it shows.
    CredentialPickResultsealed interfaceWhat VaultApi.pick(WindowHandle, CredentialPickRequest) answers.
    CredentialPresentationclassHow a credential looks in a picker, the same in a consumer's own controls as in Vault's chooser: its name, a caption, the user icon in blue for a password account and the key icon in green for every other kind.
    KindenumWhat a credential carries, and so which Credential accessors have a value: ACCOUNT_PASSWORD a username and a password; ACCOUNT_KEY a username and a private key file, with the key's passphrase when it has one; ACCOUNT_KEY_AND_PASSWORD all of these; SSH_KEY a key without a username, either stored in Vault (key bytes, with the passphrase when it has one) or a key file Vault refers to by its path.
    LockStateenumWhether a vault file exists and whether it is open: NO_VAULT while there is no vault file, LOCKED while it exists but is locked, UNLOCKED while it is open and its credentials can be listed and fetched.
    SshKeyImportResultrecordWhat VaultApi.importSshKeys stored and allowed, without secrets.
    SshKeySourcerecordOne private key file to import with VaultApi.importSshKeys.
    VaultApiinterfaceThe Credential Vault as another plugin sees it.

    Credential

    dev.jasper.vault.api
    final class Credential
    implements AutoCloseable

    The caller's own copy of a secret. Fetch it just before use and close() right after: closing zeroes the arrays and every later accessor throws IllegalStateException. The vault keeps nothing about it, so an auto-lock never invalidates a credential already in hand.

    VaultApi

    dev.jasper.vault.api
    interface VaultApi

    The Credential Vault as another plugin sees it. Obtain it with services().find(VaultApi.class) (or require) after naming dev.jasper.vault in requires; each plugin gets its own instance, and grants belong to that plugin. Every method is called on the UI thread and returns at once; every future completes on the UI thread. Cancelling a future withdraws that request, and a prompt nobody waits for any more closes.

    Fields
    #static final Topic<LockState> LOCK_STATE_CHANGED

    The new state at every lock transition, including the lock when Vault stops; subscribe with context.events().subscribe.

    Methods
    #default CompletableFuture<Optional<SshKeyImportResult>> importSshKeys(
        WindowHandle owner,
        List<SshKeySource> sources,
        List<UUID> selectedCredentials)

    Imports private key files into encrypted storage after the user reviews them in a dialog titled "Import SSH keys". Vault opens first, creating a vault when there is none, and asks for each key's passphrase when it needs one. On commit each key is stored in Vault (one already stored with the same fingerprint is reused; a key file Vault refers to by path with the same fingerprint becomes a stored key with the same id and the source's name) and this plugin gets a saved grant for every imported key and every selected credential. The interface default fails with UnsupportedOperationException; Credential Vault implements it.

    Parameters
    owner the window the dialog and prompts open over
    sources at most 4096 regular key files with distinct request ids, each at most 1 MiB holding one supported private key whose .pub file beside it, if present, matches
    selectedCredentials existing credentials to allow as well: SSH keys stored in Vault or password accounts
    Returns
    what was stored and allowed; empty when the user cancels, or the owner closes or the vault locks before the save starts; cancelled when either happens during the save, which may still complete (Vault then posts "Host import was cancelled"). Fails with IllegalArgumentException when Vault cannot open, a key cannot be read or a selected credential is neither kind, and with IllegalStateException when saving fails
    Throws
    IllegalArgumentException when there are more than 4096 sources or two share a request id
    #LockState lockState()

    Whether a vault exists and whether it is unlocked now. Needs no grant.

    Returns
    the current state
    #CompletableFuture<Boolean> ensureUnlocked(WindowHandle owner)

    Prompts for the master password over owner when the vault is locked. Every requester shares one unlock prompt: a request made while the prompt is open joins it where it is, and while the Credential Vault window is open the prompt opens in that window. Without a vault it posts a notification saying to create one and answers false.

    Parameters
    owner the window the prompt opens over
    Returns
    true once unlocked; false when the user cancels or there is no vault
    #List<CredentialDescriptor> credentials()

    Every account and SSH key, without secrets; secure notes are not listed. Needs no grant.

    Returns
    the credentials; empty unless unlocked
    #CompletableFuture<Optional<Credential>> credential(UUID id)

    The secret for id: unlocks first when needed and asks the user to allow this plugin once or always unless a grant exists. The prompts open over the window this plugin last passed to Vault while it is open, else the active or first Jasper window, except where ensureUnlocked says otherwise; a grant prompt already open for this plugin and credential is joined. Locked with no window, Vault posts a notification and answers empty. Close the result.

    Parameters
    id a credential's id
    Returns
    the secret; empty when denied, cancelled, the id is unknown or there is no vault (Vault then posts a notification saying to create one)
    #default CompletableFuture<Optional<Credential>> credential(
        WindowHandle owner,
        UUID id)

    The secret for id, as credential(UUID) fetches it, with its unlock and grant prompts over owner except where ensureUnlocked says otherwise. Empty at once when owner is null or closed; a secret that arrives after owner closes is closed and the answer is empty. The interface default ignores owner.

    Parameters
    owner the window the request comes from
    id a credential's id
    Returns
    the secret; empty when denied, cancelled, the id is unknown, owner closed or there is no vault (Vault then posts a notification saying to create one)
    #CompletableFuture<Optional<CredentialDescriptor>> pick(WindowHandle owner)

    Unlocks when needed, then lets the user choose a credential in a modal dialog titled "Choose a credential" over owner. The choice is a one-time grant for this plugin.

    Parameters
    owner the window the dialog opens over
    Returns
    the chosen credential; empty when the user cancels, there is no vault or the vault locks
    #default CompletableFuture<CredentialPickResult> pick(
        WindowHandle owner,
        CredentialPickRequest request)

    Shows Vault's credential chooser in a popover on the request's anchor, after unlocking (the unlock prompt attaches to the anchor too): a search field, a None row when the request allows clearing, a row for each credential and New Credential…, which opens Vault's own editor and then the chooser again without choosing or granting anything. Choosing a credential is a one-time grant for this plugin; naming an id in the request grants nothing. The interface default shows pick(WindowHandle) instead and answers Chosen or Cancelled.

    Parameters
    owner the window the request comes from
    request the anchor, the current credential and whether None is offered
    Returns
    the outcome
    Throws
    IllegalArgumentException when the anchor is not a live anchor Jasper issued
